decision: Retain V43 working reference. First1k does not establish convergence or a general palette repair. Continue both exact whole states to their originally planned4000 updates; no new training data, schedule or loss change.

result.limitations: Saved complete case logs, no new inference of old weights. Same observation keys/metadata and nullable control support; all classical drift recorded under the inherited four-float32-ULP bound, not exact replay. V43 real batch2 versus current/parent batch4; photo batch2. Neural FP16/physical FP32. These development source intervals do not quantify training seed uncertainty or multiple-comparison selection. Parent versus fine-tuned arm includes additional training; only current control versus wide isolates the palette intervention. V43 differs in initialization/history. No strict final, SOTA or broad real superiority claim.

notes.known: Both arms smooth the plate surface texture and simplify the bright reflection. Panel boundaries and the small bright point remain. No decisive detail difference between arms. Independent AHD RGB is not exact GT.
notes.unseen: Both arms remove grain on apples/tan surfaces but retain broad patches and faint fine texture. No decisive native detail advantage. Independent AHD RGB is not exact GT.
notes.full427: Both arms erase the fine parachute cords. The tower outline is retained, but fine cloud wisps and building detail soften; no clear native advantage between arms.
notes.analytic: Both almost erase the dark carrier; the brighter weak carrier is faint and spatially uneven. Neutral fields are smooth. Selected previews do not resolve a meaningful arm difference.
notes.gfx: Both smooth the sky, soften fine foliage/building truss and soften the chain-link mesh. They retain more coherent fence structure than the RawNIND controls, but the wider palette gives no compelling detail gain over control. The ISO100 reference differs in aperture/exposure/motion and is not GT.
notes.three-camera: Q2 dark broad texture is similarly smoothed in both arms and RawNIND. Sony input is already soft and window outlines remain soft. Both arms preserve more GF50R stone variation than RawNIND. No convincing native difference between arms and no exact GT.
notes.selected-color-CPU: Neutral looks smooth in both. Warm remains mildly biased/mottled; magenta remains visibly biased with broad low-frequency patches. The wider palette does not fix every selected color.
notes.prospective-grid-CUDA: All four neutral previews are smooth. Warm is fairly close to GT with small variation in all methods. All neural magenta previews remain biased/mottled; the released RAW cascade has a conspicuous repeated grid and hue shift. Exact uniform analytic GT, not a real photograph.

native_visual_review.scope: Selected native crops only, not exhaustive visual review of every full-frame pixel.
